<label class="block mb-xs semibold text-xs" for="framework">Framework Selector</label>
<select id="framework" class="select">
  <option>Skeletonic Stylus 2.0 (Active)</option>
  <option>Vanilla CSS</option>
</select>

<!-- Accessible Custom Checkbox (24px min-height target) -->
<label class="checkbox-field" for="sync">
  <input type="checkbox" class="checkbox" id="sync" checked />
  <span>Auto-sync with remote repository</span>
</label>

Skeletonic Stylus

Ultra-responsive CSS engine with 35 primitives and OKLCH color spaces.

WCAG 2.2 AA
Zero-JS Native Accordion
What makes Skeletonic Stylus 2.0 unique?

It compiles to native CSS with Cascade Layers, OKLCH color spaces, and 0ms JavaScript runtime overhead.

Is it compatible with Sass or Tailwind?

Yes! All compiled stylesheets are wrapped in `@layer skeletonic`, allowing seamless coexistence with any external framework without specificity conflicts.

Themed Scroll Area

Skeletonic Stylus features custom scrollbars styled via scrollbar-color and scrollbar-width: thin. They adapt effortlessly across light and dark color schemes without adding script overhead.

The 2026 Native Modal Standard

This modal is rendered in the top-layer using the native HTML5 <dialog> API and animates smoothly via @starting-style with zero JavaScript rendering libraries.

Slide-In Sheet Drawer

Discrete display and transform transitions on HTML5 dialog.

This drawer slides smoothly from the right viewport edge. It includes backdrop dimming, touch safety, and keyboard escape trapping.
